prose: The Financial Times report indexed by Techmeme says the United States and Pax Silica partners, including Japan, the United Kingdom and India, agreed to draw up a joint list of AI technologies and supply chains to protect from China. The article body was inaccessible, so the list’s contents, enforcement tools and legal status cannot be reconstructed from the headline.
highlights: Agreement concerns a joint protection list
Specific technologies are not available here
No new export prohibition is inferred
